content.value_statement: Influencer campaigns fail when audience assumptions are vague. This skill builds audience profiles, niche maps, creator criteria, and handoff notes for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Creates demographic and psychographic audience profiles with confidence labels.
Builds platform-priority matrices and media-diet maps for influencer planning.
Defines must-have, nice-to-have, and red-flag creator selection criteria.
Maps niche communities, language, norms, taboos, and key voice tiers.
Calculates a 25-point Brand Fit Score for niche entry decisions.
Produces handoff summaries for discovery, fit scoring, and content review.
limitations: Does not discover or contract specific creators.
Does not score creator shortlists on ACE, ART, ROI, or CVI.
Live platform or CRM accuracy depends on user data or configured connectors.
Inferred audience attributes must be validated before major decisions.

use_cases.title: Launch a New Influencer Program
use_cases.description: Profile the target audience and create creator selection criteria before outreach starts.

use_cases.title: Enter a Niche Community
use_cases.description: Decode community language, norms, key voices, risks, and brand fit before a partnership plan.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Campaign Underperformance
use_cases.description: Compare campaign assumptions against audience behavior, content preferences, and platform priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Target Audience
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audience mapping for a brand or product.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the target audience for [brand or product] in [category] for [geography]. Use audience mode and mark each inferred attribute with High, Med, or Low confidence.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Persona and Platform Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning with first-party customer context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an audience profile for influencer targeting from this data: [customer data summary]. Include demographics, psychographics, media diet, platform priorities, and one named persona.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Niche Community
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced community entry and cultural-risk analysis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research the [niche or subculture] community for [brand]. Use niche mode. Map key voices, language, norms, taboos, content formats, Brand Fit Score, and red lines.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Discovery Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced handoff into creator discovery and scoring.
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the audience or niche analysis below, create the handoff summary for influencer discovery. Include must-have criteria, nice-to-have criteria, red flags, assumptions, evidence, and open loops. [paste analysis]

output_examples.input: Analyze a premium skincare audience for millennial women in the United States.
output: Primary audience profile with age, income, lifestyle, values, and confidence labels.
Instagram and TikTok platform priority matrix with content format guidance.
Creator criteria covering trust signals, aesthetic fit, and red flags.

output_examples.input: Research the BookTok community for a new reading app.
output: Community map with subgroups, key voice tiers, language, norms, and taboos.
Brand Fit Score with entry risks, mitigations, and phased participation plan.
Red lines for outreach and content that could damage credibility.

output_examples.input: Diagnose why our creator campaign missed engagement goals.
output: Gap analysis between assumed audience behavior and actual media habits.
Recommended platform mix, creator profile changes, and content topics to test.

best_practices: Provide first-party customer data when available, and label sensitive data clearly.
Choose audience mode for broad customer understanding and niche mode for community entry.
Use the handoff summary before running creator discovery or fit scoring.
anti_patterns: Treating inferred personas as proven facts without validation.
Skipping the culture decode before entering a niche community.
Using the Brand Fit Score as a creator ACE or CVI score.

faq.question: Does this skill find specific influencers?
faq.answer: No. It creates the audience or niche criteria that a discovery skill can use later.

faq.question: What is the difference between audience mode and niche mode?
faq.answer: Audience mode profiles customers. Niche mode decodes a community, its culture, voices, risks, and brand fit.

faq.question: Can it work without live platform data?
faq.answer: Yes. It can reason from user inputs, but live data improves confidence and specificity.

faq.question: Does it save results automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructs the agent to ask before saving memory or promoting durable facts.

faq.question: Can it score a creator shortlist?
faq.answer: No. Use a fit scoring skill after this skill defines audience facts and selection criteria.

faq.question: What should I provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide the brand, category, geography, objective, known customer data, target platforms, and any prior campaign learnings.
